reason: Reviewed the basis/covolume definition and its determinant dependency. If B and C are lattice basis matrices and C=BA, B=CA', both change matrices are integral; substitution gives AA'=A'A=I, so the basis-change determinant is ±1 and covolume is basis-independent. The discreteness/spanning equivalence is supported by the audited Milne Lemma 4.14 and Proposition 4.15 route.
